evidence.quote: The tuition fee of the BSc program for two semesters (3,800 Euro) must be paid by bank transfer to the bank account of the university given above.

notes: The application procedure page is the only page that describes the Computer Science BSc programme. It covers both the BSc in Computer Science and the MSc in Computer Science Engineering jointly for several sections; quotes used here apply to the BSc programme. No explicit statement about the language of instruction; not extracted. No applicationChannel extracted: the page says applicants can apply online but does not name a platform or route clearly enough to assign one.
